close_reason: pio project config --json-output resolves extends and interpolation (used by the rail test); JUnit report from pio test is parsed by scripts/check_junit_suites.py and worked on the runner; suite count is asserted by the checker so an unmatched -f filter fails regardless of exit status. Evidence: quake-ci run 41173001875 on PR 45.

title: Measure cold-cache quake-ci cost and decide build reuse and native_quake
description: Phase A items 3 and 8. On a scratch branch time: pio native tests for the four suites, the stock smoke build, and a cold-cache build of both images. Decide (a) a small native_quake env vs the stock native env, (b) share builds between quake-ci and quake-repeater-release.yml or accept the duplicate. Record numbers in specs/001-keymind-separation/research.md. Acceptance: p90 plan for under 15 min is credible or the plan is amended.
close_reason: First quake-ci run on PR 45 (run 41173001875): tests job 51 s, image builds 135-150 s, stock smoke builds 154-160 s, release-metadata 8 s, whole check about 3.5 minutes wall clock, against the 15 minute target. Decisions: no native_quake env needed (four suites take seconds); the duplicate build between quake-ci and the release workflow is accepted for now (cold-cache numbers are small); revisit only if cost matters.

title: Separate the Quake Repeater CI and releases from Keymind

Every settings change needs the owner's approval; nothing here is applied until its task says so.
